subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the guard assertions are repaired and the final exact head is green, should the credentialed, security-scanning, publishing, repository-automation, and Codex action upgrades land as one grouped rollup?
rationale: Automated validation can prove pin consistency, but it cannot authorize coordinated replacement of executable third-party code across several credential and security owner boundaries.

options.title: Approve grouped rollup
options.body: Repair the assertions, validate the exact head, and land the verified official action revisions together.

options.title: Split privileged families
options.body: Separate token, publishing, scanning, automation, and Codex action updates for narrower owner review.

options.title: Pause the rollup
options.body: Close or supersede the PR if automated rebases cannot preserve the required repository-specific guard repairs.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped rollup
recommendation.body: Repair the assertions, validate the exact head, and land the verified official action revisions together.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the affected guard coverage and is the strongest individual routing candidate alongside the CODEOWNERS secops team.
